claude.sample_unit: patients (development cohort; 7,456 CT slices); external cohorts 203 and 141 patients

links.outcome: Patient-level AUROC under slice-random (leakage-prone) versus patient-grouped evaluation
links.effect: Patient-level AUROC 0.9902–0.9997 under E1 fell to 0.7018–0.7342 under E3; paired E1-minus-E3 differences 0.2559–0.2971, bootstrap CIs excluding zero for all architectures.
links.quote: Patient-level AUROC ranged from 0.9902–0.9997 under E1 and decreased to 0.7018–0.7342 under E3.

links.outcome: Performance of locked models on external cohorts from other sites
links.effect: External AUROC fell to 0.5973–0.6298 in External A and 0.5040–0.6084 in External B; all External B CIs included 0.50.
links.quote: External AUROC decreased further to 0.5973–0.6298 in External A and 0.5040–0.6084 in External B.

links.outcome: Cross-cohort transportability of development-only models without fine-tuning or recalibration
links.effect: Calibration deteriorated after external transfer; locked E3 thresholds gave cohort-dependent sensitivity–specificity tradeoffs; External A CIs above 0.50, External B CIs included 0.50.
links.quote: Calibration deteriorated after external transfer, and locked E3-derived thresholds produced cohort-dependent sensitivity–specificity tradeoffs.

unlisted_practices: Patient-grouped data partitioning to prevent same-patient slice leakage across train/test folds
